work.title: The Tragedy of Hamlet, Prince of Denmark
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 4, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. A room in the Castle.

content.text: Enter King, Queen, Rosencrantz and Guildenstern.

lines.text: There's matter in these sighs. These profound heaves
lines.plainText: There's matter in these sighs These profound heaves

lines.text: You must translate; 'tis fit we understand them.
lines.plainText: You must translate 'tis fit we understand them

lines.text: Where is your son?
lines.plainText: Where is your son

lines.text: Bestow this place on us a little while.
lines.plainText: Bestow this place on us a little while

content.text: [To Rosencrantz and Guildenstern, who go out.]

lines.text: What, Gertrude? How does Hamlet?
lines.plainText: What Gertrude How does Hamlet

lines.text: Mad as the sea and wind, when both contend
lines.plainText: Mad as the sea and wind when both contend

lines.text: Which is the mightier. In his lawless fit
lines.plainText: Which is the mightier In his lawless fit

lines.text: Behind the arras hearing something stir,
lines.plainText: Behind the arras hearing something stir

lines.text: Whips out his rapier, cries 'A rat, a rat!'
lines.plainText: Whips out his rapier cries 'A rat a rat'

lines.text: And in this brainish apprehension kills
lines.plainText: And in this brainish apprehension kills

lines.text: The unseen good old man.
lines.plainText: The unseen good old man

lines.text: O heavy deed!
lines.plainText: O heavy deed

lines.text: It had been so with us, had we been there.
lines.plainText: It had been so with us had we been there

lines.text: His liberty is full of threats to all;
lines.plainText: His liberty is full of threats to all

lines.text: To you yourself, to us, to everyone.
lines.plainText: To you yourself to us to everyone

lines.text: Alas, how shall this bloody deed be answer'd?
lines.plainText: Alas how shall this bloody deed be answer'd

lines.text: It will be laid to us, whose providence
lines.plainText: It will be laid to us whose providence

lines.text: Should have kept short, restrain'd, and out of haunt
lines.plainText: Should have kept short restrain'd and out of haunt

lines.text: This mad young man. But so much was our love
lines.plainText: This mad young man But so much was our love

lines.text: We would not understand what was most fit,
lines.plainText: We would not understand what was most fit

lines.text: But like the owner of a foul disease,
lines.plainText: But like the owner of a foul disease

lines.text: To keep it from divulging, let it feed
lines.plainText: To keep it from divulging let it feed

lines.text: Even on the pith of life. Where is he gone?
lines.plainText: Even on the pith of life Where is he gone

lines.text: To draw apart the body he hath kill'd,
lines.plainText: To draw apart the body he hath kill'd

lines.text: O'er whom his very madness, like some ore
lines.plainText: O'er whom his very madness like some ore

lines.text: Among a mineral of metals base,
lines.plainText: Among a mineral of metals base

lines.text: Shows itself pure. He weeps for what is done.
lines.plainText: Shows itself pure He weeps for what is done

lines.text: O Gertrude, come away!
lines.plainText: O Gertrude come away

lines.text: The sun no sooner shall the mountains touch
lines.plainText: The sun no sooner shall the mountains touch

lines.text: But we will ship him hence, and this vile deed
lines.plainText: But we will ship him hence and this vile deed

lines.text: We must with all our majesty and skill
lines.plainText: We must with all our majesty and skill

lines.text: Both countenance and excuse.—Ho, Guildenstern!
lines.plainText: Both countenance and excuseHo Guildenstern
